title: WKS Case Definition
description: A case type: the config-driven template for cases. Part of the WKS Case Configuration Standard. Self-contained (internal $defs only) so it validates identically across JSON Schema validators in any language.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for the case type (slug).

formKey.description: Key of the Form whose structure renders this case type's data.

stagesLifecycleProcessKey.description: Key of the BPMN process driving the stage lifecycle. Empty/absent when running engine-less (wks.bpm.engine=none).

deployed.description: Whether this case type is available to end users.

caseHooks.description: Event-driven automation: on a matching event, apply actions (stage/queue transitions).

requiredDocuments.description: Document requirements for this case type: the documents a case of this type is expected to hold. Drives the case Documents checklist and completeness. Absent/empty means no declared requirements (cases fall back to free-form attachments).

sourceDiagram.description: The diagram this case type was modelled as, as SVG markup. Display only: the case shows the model it came from, with the current stage and the milestones reached marked on it (stages and milestones carry the sourceElementId of the element they were generated from). Attached by an importer rather than authored; absent for hand-built case types. Untrusted markup — sanitise before rendering. Part of the WKS Case Configuration Standard since schema 2.3.

bpmEngineId.description: Legacy field present in seed data. Not modeled on the engine's CaseDefinition and silently ignored on read. Documented here so the schema does not flag it; do not rely on it.

_id.description: Storage envelope field (e.g. MongoDB ObjectId wrapper). Not part of the logical config contract.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the WKS Case Configuration Standard this document conforms to. Absent/null is treated as the 1.0 pre-versioning baseline. Current: 2.3 (2.0 removed kanbanConfig — board rendering derives from stages, see board-config.schema.json; 2.1 adds requiredDocuments; 2.2 adds per-stage milestones; 2.3 adds sourceDiagram).

documentRequirement.description: A single declared document requirement for a case type.

id.description: Stable identifier for the requirement (slug). Uploaded documents reference this via CaseDocument.requirementId to mark the requirement satisfied.

label.description: Human-readable name of the required document (e.g. "Passport", "Proof of Address").

description.description: Optional guidance shown to the user about what to provide.

required.description: Whether the document is mandatory for case completeness. Absent is treated as true.

acceptedFileTypes.description: Optional allow-list of file extensions/MIME hints (e.g. ["pdf", "png"]). Advisory in this slice; absent means any type.

maxSizeBytes.description: Optional maximum file size in bytes. Advisory in this slice.

id.description: Stage identifier (string, typically the ordinal as text).

sourceElementId.description: Optional id of the element this stage was generated from in an imported source model (e.g. a CMMN Stage's planItem id). Enables marking the stage on the original diagram; absent for a hand-authored stage, or one with no single source shape.

processesDefinitions.description: BPMN processes bound to this stage (manually or auto-started).

milestones.description: Milestones achievable while the case is in this stage: named points of progress that are recorded on the case instance once reached. Independent of stage transitions — a stage may declare several, and reaching one does not move the case. Absent/empty means the stage tracks no milestones. Part of the WKS Case Configuration Standard since schema 2.2.

caseMilestone.description: A single milestone declared on a stage.

id.description: Stable identifier for the milestone (slug). Case instances record achievement by this id, and automation signals it by this id, so it must not change once cases exist.

name.description: Human-readable milestone name, shown on the case. Displayed as authored — not translated.

note.description: Optional free-text note about what achieving this milestone means (e.g. carried over from a source model's annotation).

sourceElementId.description: Optional id of the element this milestone was generated from in an imported source model (e.g. a CMMN Milestone's planItem id). Enables highlighting the original diagram; absent for hand-authored milestones.

eventType.description: Event that triggers the hook. Vocabulary pinned to com.wks.caseengine.tasks.event.complete.CaseEventType.

processDefKey.description: BPMN process key the event must originate from.

taskDefKey.description: BPMN task key whose completion fires the hook.

newStage.description: Target stage. NOTE: holds the stage NAME, not its id (matches current engine + portal behavior).

queueId.description: Target queue. NOTE: holds the queue NAME despite the field name (matches current engine + portal behavior).
